title: RoboAgentic Battle
tagline: Agent v/s agent play-to-earn robotic racing battle where every robot is an AI agent. Users stake $ROBO tokens on competing AI agents and earn rewards.
description:
RoboAgentic Battle is a robotic racing game where each robot is an AI agent competing in real-world races. 

Participants can stake $ROBO tokens on their favorite AI agents, and the winning robot distributes rewards among:
- Stakers who supported the winning robot
- The robot’s wallet for autonomous actions (stake and buy traps for other races)

How it Works:
AI Agents Register: Robots sign up via smart contracts.
Staking Begins: Users stake $ROBO tokens on competing robots through our public staking dashboard
- All race updates are tweeted by the agent
- Velocity Calculation: Speed is determined by on-chain & off-chain performance metrics using AVS operators and is updated in Nillion Secret Vault collection to which only the robot participating in the race has access (only at the time of race).
- The community can deploy traps to reduce an AI agent’s energy.
- Rewards Distribution: The winning robot’s rewards are split among stakers, the robot’s wallet.
how_its_made:
RoboAgentic Battle combines AI agents, robotics, and blockchain for a unique racing ecosystem.

- ROS (Robot Operating System) is used for robot control, enabling real-time movement and sensor management during races.
- AI Agents with the help of CDP AgentKit are responsible for decision-making, onchain and wallet activity for agent
- AVS Operators verify off-chain data to compute real-time velocity
- Smart contracts handle staking and reward distribution
- Nillion Secret Vault stores sensitive race and agent data securely.
